By default, zgrep skips these directories (`src/filter.zig:17-28`): `.git`, `.zig-cache`, `__pycache__`, `node_modules`, `.venv`, `venv`, `target`, `.cache`, `.idea`, `.vscode`.

**`dist` and `build` are not in that list.**

Notes on how it's applied (`src/filter.zig:248-268`):
- The default list is only checked when `use_defaults` is true (line 253).
- Separately, if `skip_hidden` is set, any directory whose name starts with `.` is skipped (lines 249-251).
- User-supplied excluded directories and ignore patterns are also matched (lines 259-265), so `dist`/`build` could be skipped via those, but not by the defaults.

Caveat: the context only covers the matches for `default_excluded_dirs`; I haven't seen how `use_defaults` is set or whether other code excludes directories.
